## UK Skilled Worker Visa Application Overview

Applying for a UK Skilled Worker Visa as a non-EU citizen in Q4 2024 requires a comprehensive set of documents to demonstrate eligibility under the UK's points-based immigration system. This checklist outlines the core requirements based on current guidance.

## Core Application Document Checklist
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/file-earmark-text.svg

To ensure a smooth application process, gather the following essential documents:

*   **Valid Passport**: Your current passport must be valid for at least six months beyond your intended stay and have blank pages for a visa.
*   **Previous Passports**: Any expired passports you have held.
*   **Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) Reference Number**: This unique reference number is provided by your UK sponsoring employer. It confirms your job offer and details.
*   **Job Offer Letter**: An official letter from your UK employer outlining your role, salary, start date, and other employment terms.
*   **Academic Qualifications**: Original certificates and transcripts for your relevant degrees, diplomas, or professional qualifications.
*   **Curriculum Vitae (CV)/Resume**: An up-to-date document detailing your education and work history.
*   **English Language Proficiency Evidence**: One of the following:
    *   An approved English language test certificate (e.g., IELTS Academic UKVI, PTE Academic UKVI) from a Home Office approved provider.
    *   A degree certificate taught in English, along with a letter from the university confirming the medium of instruction was English.
    *   Proof of nationality from a majority English-speaking country (e.g., USA, Canada, Australia).
*   **Financial Maintenance Evidence**: One of the following:
    *   Bank statements showing you have held at least £1,270 in your account for a consecutive 28-day period, ending no more than 31 days before your application.
    *   Confirmation on your Certificate of Sponsorship that your employer will cover your maintenance costs for the first month.
*   **Tuberculosis (TB) Test Certificate**: Required if you are applying from one of the countries on the Home Office's specified list. The test must be from an approved clinic.
*   **Overseas Criminal Record Certificate**: Required if you are applying for certain professions (e.g., healthcare, social care, education) or if you have lived in certain countries for 12 months or more in the last 10 years. Check specific guidance for your profession and country of residence.
*   **Biometric Information**: You will attend an appointment at a visa application centre to provide your fingerprints and a photograph.

## Additional Requirements & Considerations

*   **Document Translations**: Any documents not in English or Welsh must be accompanied by a full, certified translation by a professional translator.
*   **Dependent Family Members**: If family members (spouse, children) are applying with you, they will need their own documents, including passports, marriage/birth certificates, and financial evidence.
*   **Application Date**: This guidance is for applications in Q4 2024. Immigration rules can change, so always refer to official government sources for the most up-to-date information.
